channel.name: Theo Browne
channel.description: Theo is a software dev, AI nerd, TypeScript sympathizer, creator of T3 Chat and the T3 Stack.

title: What’s the best programming language for AI?
description:
You'd probably think that Python or TypeScript is the best language for AI. Turns out it's not..

Thank you Greptile for Sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/greptile
